name: Oko, Thief of Crowns
oracle_text:
+2: Create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")
+1: Target artifact or creature loses all abilities and becomes a green Elk creature with base power and toughness 3/3.
−5: Exchange control of target artifact or creature you control and target creature an opponent controls with power 3 or less.
blocked_sentences: +1: Target artifact or creature loses all abilities and becomes a green Elk creature with base power and toughness 3/3.
−5: Exchange control of target artifact or creature you control and target creature an opponent controls with power 3 or less.

needs.what: an animate with no end-of-turn expiry that SETS characteristics rather than adding to them: the target becomes a green Elk creature with base P/T 3/3 indefinitely -- its colour becomes exactly green, its card types become exactly Creature (an artifact stops being an artifact), its creature types become exactly Elk (layer 4/5/7b, per Oko's rulings) -- paired with the existing lose_all_abilities op
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op animate (primitives.animate) stores a TempEffect in until_eot, so it wears off at cleanup, and it ADDS types/subtypes to what is printed ('it's still a land'), so an Oko'd artifact would stay an artifact and keep its other creature types. It takes no duration key. set_types/set_colors/set_pt exist only as statics read off the printed face, not as a one-shot op on a target; grant_ability's op cannot grant a static. lose_all_abilities op itself is fine (permanent).

needs.what: an atomic exchange of control between two targeted permanents (701.12): each controller gains control of the other's permanent, permanently; if either target is illegal on resolution, or both have the same controller, no exchange happens at all
needs.why_existing_wont_do: gain_control moves one set of objects to one player. Two gain_control ops are not an exchange: the second would need 'the player who controlled the other target' as its player (no such player spec), and if one target became illegal the other half would still happen, which 701.12b forbids. aura_swap is an exchange but only Aura-in-hand for Aura-on-battlefield.
